idea-plugin.name: NuGet License Gate
idea-plugin.description:
Flags AutoMapper 15+, MediatR 13+, FluentAssertions 8+, MassTransit 9+ and other NuGet versions past their licence line, with the pin

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → NuGet License Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 10 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/nuget-commercial-license-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/nuget-commercial-license-gate

action.text: NuGet License Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run NuGet License Gate on the file in the editor
